svg.title: The SPlit.jl pipeline offers four row-selection lanes
svg.desc: Data is preprocessed, then one of four equally presented methods chooses n rows: support points followed by nearest-neighbor claiming, kernel herding, twinning, or kernel thinning. Chosen rows form the smaller split side and the remaining rows form the other side.
